name: TaskTab - New Tab for Google Tasks
description: A browser extension that opens Google Tasks in a new tab

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ws://localhost:3000 http://localhost:3000; frame-src https://tasks.google.com; img-src 'self' https: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:;
